# Tag fixture (P2.3)
One seeded rule per new tag, plus a control with an old tag.
## Secrets [security]
- Keep secrets out of the repository. (KB addition) {#tags.security.no-secrets}
## Dependencies [supply-chain]

## Pipeline [ci]
- Require the verify check before merging. (KB addition) {#tags.ci.required-check}
## Workflow [process]

## Interfaces [design]
- Version public APIs. (KB addition) {#tags.design.version-apis}
## Experience [ux]

## Control [backend]
